notes: MakeShape::MakeShapeCircle(shape 0): the dance shape's 256 points (i32 x, z pairs) into DanceShapePoints 0xCADB70 + shape * 0x800, at the game's 24-bit precision (docs/bw1-notes/dances.md, Shapes). One case: the function has no inputs. Variants in specs/variants/MakeShape*.json cover shapes 1, 2, 3, 8, 9 and 10. openblack: src/ECS/DanceShapes.cpp.
